messages:
Avery (CEO): Quick post-all-hands thread for runtime Qs — batching, KV caching, kernels. Drop short questions here.

Maya (Eng Manager): Which items are for immediate rollout vs research?

Rohit (VP Eng): Immediate: KV invalidation bug + safer batching heuristic + better SLI dashboards. Research: attention fusion and alternative matmul kernels.

Jon (Runtime): KV fix PR rw-kv-271 in review. Canary planned next week on canary cluster.

Linh (ML Infra): Attention fusion prototype shows ~10% long-seq gains in lab, but increases register usage on Turing-era GPUs — needs more testing.

Camille (Product): Any customer-facing risk?

Rohit (VP Eng): Minimal. Hosted gets staged rollout + auto-fallback. Dedicated can opt-in to betas with SE assistance.

Jon (Runtime): Note: increasing batch-window can raise tail for tiny bursty requests. Mitigation: small-request heuristic (requests <32 tokens) bypasses long-window batching.

Maya (Eng Manager): Ops rollout plan: canary -> 24h monitoring -> staged -> global. SLIs: p50/p95 token latency, errors, tokens/sec.

Rohit (VP Eng): Timeline: KV canary next week; batching safe rollout in ~2 sprints; attention fusion prototype this quarter.

deploy-bot: Canary started for rw-kv-271 on us-west-2-canary. CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/run/10177

Jon (Runtime): Early canary: p50 down ~7%, p95 steady. Will report back in 6h.

Avery (CEO): Thanks — closing in 24h unless new Qs. Move remaining items to runtime roadmap epic.
